text: Read the values in your opening hand and decide which matter most to you.
Trade cards across the table, explaining what you are seeking and what you can release.
Compare final hands and examine the compromises, refusals, and assumptions behind them.
Take a role and inspect the information and responsibilities available to you.
Share evidence, form proposals, and decide how the group will make a binding choice.
Reconstruct the decision together: whose knowledge travelled, whose did not, and why.
